resources.string: Lets a family member see this phone\'s location only when they ask for it. Nothing is sent otherwise. While it is on, a notification stays visible so everyone using this phone knows.
I am sharing THIS phone\'s location willingly — it is my own phone, or I know and agree that it is being shared.
Please tick the box to confirm you are sharing this phone\'s location willingly.
ON — this phone will answer location requests.
Please fill in the server and key.
Server must start with http:// or https://
Location permission is needed to share location.
For sharing while the app is closed, choose \"Allow all the time\".

This app does not hide itself. A notification is always shown while sharing, and sharing can be stopped from this screen at any time. Intended for sharing your own device, or a child\'s device with their knowledge.
